qa_pair.question: The legacy "learning" email signature is drawn in a single brand colour, and that colour is also the light-theme hex of one of the seven Studio minerals. What is that mineral's semantic role? Answer with the role word only.
Exactly one top-level brand's email signature is drawn in the light-theme hex of the mineral whose role is Stewardship. Which brand is it? Answer with the brand slug only.
The Mukoko email signature carries a tagline that differs from Mukoko's tagline in the brand registry. What tagline does the signature show? Answer with the exact text, no quotes.
What is the pixel area of the Studio card canvas made for LinkedIn share images (width multiplied by height)? Answer with the integer only, no separators.
Of the six Studio card formats, which has the largest height-to-width ratio? Answer with the format key only.
Nyuchi Africa has four divisions, each on its own subdomain. For exactly one of them the subdomain's first label is not the division's key. Which division is it? Answer with the division key only.
How many divisions are there across all four top-level Bundu-ecosystem brands combined? Answer with the number only.

Generate a Studio card titled "Ubuntu" for the mineral whose role is Identity, using layout 1 and the Open Graph link-preview format, with no explicit seed. What seed does the server report? Answer with the integer only.

Someone asks for a "meet this mineral" card for the mineral whose dark-theme hex is #FF8A65. The mineral_education_card prompt says to use the mineral's role as the card's dek or eyebrow. What word is that? Answer with the role word only.
Among the four top-level brands, which one is not the foundation pillar yet has no divisions and no social links in the brand registry? Answer with the brand slug only.
